study type: Retrospective cohort study and comparative study
cohort: Women who delivered at Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital and Chris Hani Baragwaneth Academic Hospital in Johannesburg, South Africa, between 2005 and 2019, totaling 398,102 deliveries.
finding: Operative vaginal delivery (OVD) rates showed specific trends at the two hospitals, with CHBAH seeing an increase from 2005-2014 followed by a decline, and CMJAH showing fluctuating rates; overall OVD rates were higher among younger, nulliparous, HIV-negative, and underweight women.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery (OVD) rates demonstrated temporal trends at two academic hospitals and were associated with younger maternal age, nulliparity, HIV-negative status, and underweight maternal status.
